Cron needs CRON_SECRET (else 401), maxDuration 300s; fillPipeline gets a 230s deadline.
A failed check becomes a health problem.

/api/import accepts IMPORT_TOKEN or CRON_SECRET. Bad project/persona/payload → 400;
then it calls lib/ingest.ts directly.
